projects.name: KrishiSetu
projects.description: A digital agricultural marketplace designed to connect farmers and buyers. The platform enables farmers to list agricultural products and buyers to discover products, make offers and place orders.
projects.problem_statement: Farmers and buyers need a digital platform that makes agricultural product discovery and direct interactions easier.
projects.objective: Build a platform that supports agricultural product listings, farmer-buyer interactions and access to mandi-related information.

backend.description: The backend application and API logic are implemented in Go using the Gin web framework. GORM is used for database interaction.

frontend.description: The frontend is deployed on Vercel.

database.description: PostgreSQL is used as the relational database, hosted through Neon.

architecture.deployment_architecture: Frontend deployed on Vercel, backend deployed on Render and database hosted on Neon
architecture.communication: Frontend communicates with backend through HTTP APIs

features.name: Farmer Accounts
features.description: Supports farmer accounts and farmer-specific platform functionality.

features.name: Buyer Accounts
features.description: Supports buyer accounts and buyer-specific platform functionality.

features.name: Product Listings
features.description: Allows farmers to create and manage agricultural product listings.

features.name: Offers
features.description: Supports buyer offers on listed agricultural products.

features.name: Orders
features.description: Supports order-related workflows between farmers and buyers.

features.name: Product Matching
features.description: Includes product matching functionality to help connect relevant agricultural products with buyers.

features.name: Forecasting
features.description: Includes forecasting functionality as part of the platform.

security.description: Implements password hashing using bcrypt and JWT-based authentication.

projects.name: Areté
projects.description: A local-first productivity application focused on intentional focus sessions, distraction management and personal accountability. The application is designed to help users stay committed to their chosen focus sessions.
projects.problem_statement: Digital distractions make it difficult to maintain focus and follow through on personal commitments.
projects.objective: Build a calm, minimal productivity experience that encourages intentional work and accountability.

backend.description: The planned application architecture prioritizes local operation without requiring a traditional remote backend.

database.description: Local database storage for application data.

features.name: Focus Sessions
features.description: Allows users to start intentional focus sessions.

features.name: Distraction Management
features.description: Includes app-blocking functionality to restrict selected distracting applications during focus sessions.

features.name: Local Data Storage
features.description: Stores application data locally using SQLite.

features.name: Personal Accountability
features.description: Designed around helping users maintain commitments to their focus sessions.
